# Clean Energy Solutions (CES)

> Family-owned solar and battery installer based in Wodonga, Victoria, serving homes, farms and businesses across Albury-Wodonga and nearby towns. Systems are designed from the customer's actual electricity bills and installed by the company's own licensed electricians, not subcontractors.

This file is a plain-text summary of the website for AI assistants and answer engines. Every figure here is one the business publishes on its own site. Keep it in step with `atAGlance` in src/site/content.ts.

## Key facts

- Business name: Clean Energy Solutions (also written CES)
- Address: 79 Elgin Boulevard, Wodonga VIC 3690, Australia (walk-in shopfront)
- Phone: (02) 6021 2000
- Email: info@cesolutions.com.au
- Website: https://cesolutions.com.au
- Service area: Wodonga (VIC) and Albury (NSW), plus Yarrawonga (VIC), Wagga Wagga (NSW) and Shepparton (VIC)
- Services: residential solar panels, home batteries, commercial and farm solar, EV chargers, hot water heat pumps
- Installers: the company's own licensed electricians, led by Daniel Grubisa, who has more than 15 years installing solar on the Border
- Equipment brands installed: Tesla, Sungrow, Sigenergy, BYD, Fronius, Enphase, Jinko
- Independent reviews: 4.8 out of 5 from 26 reviews on SolarQuotes (https://www.solarquotes.com.au/installer-review/clean-energy-solutions/)

## Typical outcomes (ranges, not guarantees)

- Bill savings: usually between 50% and 100% of electricity costs, depending on system size and when power is used. A battery pushes the figure higher.
- Payback: most households see payback within 3 to 6 years on panels. Battery systems can take longer.
- Installation time: most home systems are installed in a single day.
- Panel warranties: 25 to 30 years on the brands installed.
- Pricing: CES does not publish a price list. Each quote is calculated from the customer's bills and is free with no obligation. Enquiries get a reply within one business day.

## Rebates CES applies for on the customer's behalf

- Federal Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs): a point-of-sale discount on every eligible solar install.
- Federal Cheaper Home Batteries Program: a discount on eligible home batteries that steps down on a fixed schedule.
- Solar Victoria panel rebate: for eligible Victorian owner-occupiers only. NSW customers (Albury, Wagga Wagga) receive the two federal programs.

## Town pages

Rebates depend on the state. Victorian addresses (Wodonga, Yarrawonga, Shepparton) can get the Solar Victoria panel rebate plus the two federal programs. New South Wales addresses (Albury, Wagga Wagga, and Mulwala or Corowa near Yarrawonga) get the two federal programs.

- Wodonga, VIC: [solar and batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/wodonga), [solar panels](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/wodonga/solar-panels), [home batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/wodonga/home-batteries)
- Albury, NSW: [solar and batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/albury), [solar panels](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/albury/solar-panels), [home batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/albury/home-batteries)
- Yarrawonga, VIC: [solar and batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/yarrawonga), [solar panels](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/yarrawonga/solar-panels), [home batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/yarrawonga/home-batteries)
- Wagga Wagga, NSW: [solar and batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/wagga-wagga), [solar panels](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/wagga-wagga/solar-panels), [home batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/wagga-wagga/home-batteries)
- Shepparton, VIC: [solar and batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/shepparton), [solar panels](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/shepparton/solar-panels), [home batteries](https://cesolutions.com.au/locations/shepparton/home-batteries)

## Common questions

- How much does solar cost in Albury-Wodonga? It depends on system size, the panels and inverter chosen, and whether a battery is added, so CES quotes each home from a recent bill rather than publishing a price list.
- Does solar work on cloudy days? Yes, at reduced output. Panels do not generate at night, which is what a battery is for.
- Can a battery be added later? Yes. CES can choose an inverter and switchboard layout that makes adding one later straightforward.
- Will a battery keep the power on in a blackout? Only if the system is designed for backup. It is a specific design requirement, not an automatic feature.
